newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells 30.443 bln levs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells 30.443 bln levs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry on Friday sold two discount T-bill issues with maturities of one week and four weeks, yielding 3.67 percent and 16.35 percent to maturity, respectively, the central bank said.
Bids were received for a total of 40.238 billion levs of T-bills but the ministry approved bids for 30.443 billion levs worth of paper.
The issues were offered with no par value or minimum acceptable price set in advance by the ministry. Auction date and maturity date for each issue overlap.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Bids received 20,404.8 million levs 19,833.3 million levs
Bids approved 16,709.8 million levs 13,733.3 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 3.67 pct 16.35 pct
